source.name: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada Spectrum Management System Broadcasting Database

policy.operationalRule: BANNER=O; DAY requires STATUS1=OP and POWERDAY>0; NIGHT requires STATUS2=OP and POWERNIGHT>0
policy.identityRule: Prefer current ISED callsign and documented backward callsign lineage from modcall.dbf; site/engineering fallback only if lineage yields no LMS candidate
policy.plottingRule: Overlay selects existing LMS pattern IDs only; ISED engineering values are never substituted into LMS geometry
policy.lowPowerRule: 40-watt Canadian operations are intentionally ignored for active-pattern matching
policy.engineeringComparisonOnly: For candidate identification only: LMS tower order may be reassociated, LMS electrical height 0.0 may be treated as missing, a common phase-reference offset may be removed, and all field ratios may be compared after one common scale factor. These operations never alter or replace LMS geometry.
policy.hardGeometryGuardrail: The overlay contains only references to existing LMS pattern IDs. It never emits replacement tower geometry, ratios, phases, spacing, orientation, height, or coordinates.
policy.activeSelectionRule: Only MATCHED and MATCHED_FALLBACK modes are emitted into the active pattern-ID overlay. MATCHED_PROBABLE remains diagnostic and is not treated as active automatically.
